selection: Choose one single-feature rule per coin/lane by earlier-year net win rate, tie mean netR then ID. At least40 trades,25percent retention,5 net>3R winners. Purge training labels exiting at/after split. Check later year unchanged; Holm4 for selected tests, known history not fresh OOS.
cohorts: Primary actual net realized>3R versus initialSL with certain pre-stop grossMFE<1R. Gross>3R sensitivity counts also reported. Stop-bar ambiguous reaches excluded from early-loss cohort; open boundary marks excluded.5m primary,15m corroboration; reference retrospective descriptive,causal executable comparison. No Langlang or2h exit.
controls: Attach frozen same symbol/side/year/week/volatility/clock-phase/random-risk counterfactual to each retained signal. Random does not necessarily pass the signal-shape filter; not claimed as a filtered random strategy.
